rule: A PATT file whose name, header or content identifies a third-party origin is excluded (EXCLUDED third_party_file). Files without such evidence are used under PATT's MIT licence as a disclosed ASSUMPTION; a missing header does not prove authorship.
scope_of_review: Every .md/.txt file under the nine PATT directories of the planned PATT-sourced categories (SQL Injection, XSS Injection, Directory Traversal, File Inclusion, Command Injection, Server Side Template Injection, Server Side Request Forgery, Open Redirect, NoSQL Injection): first ~12 lines of every .txt read, comment lines grepped, keyword grep (fuzzdb, wapiti, rsnake, ha.ckers, jhaddix, portswigger, seclists, sqlmap, brutelogic, dotdotpwn, jbrofuzz), and distinct-line overlap with the denied files. Review was done offline; no licence was verified over the network.
